def merge_lists(list_a, list_b):

    lower_case_list_b = to_lower_case_dict(list_b)

    from datetime import datetime, time
    
    current_time = datetime.strptime(now, "%H:%M").time()
    
    # Initialize the next bus time to a time object for the next day

    # If the current time is after the last bus of the day, calculate the time to the first bus of the next day

        # Calculate the time to the first bus of the next day
